HKEX:388 Launches AI And Semiconductor Indices
: HKEX (388) launched two new indices: an AI index tracking 40 Hong Kong-listed firms across the AI ecosystem and a Semiconductor index tracking 30 major Hong Kong semiconductor-related companies.
